preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 1000.
The size of the polygon n must be between 1 and 50 for each test case.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(c) <= 1 for row in matrix for c in row)
preconditions.description: Each cell in the matrix must contain either 0 or 1.

postconditions.description: The output must be either 'YES' or 'NO' for each test case.

postconditions.expression: any(any(row[j] == 1 for j in range(n)) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: If the output is 'YES', there must be at least one 1 in the matrix.

postconditions.expression: all(all(row[j] == 0 for j in range(n)) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: If the output is 'NO', all cells in the matrix must be 0.
